title: 2024年6月四级真题 第1套 阅读1
paperTitle: 2024年6月大学英语四级真题（第1套）
passage:
P1 Lao Zi once said, "Care about what other people think and you will always be their prisoner."

P2 People-pleasing, or seeking self-worth through others' approval, is unproductive and an exhausting way to go through life. Why do we allow what others think of us to have so much power over how we feel about ourselves? If it's true that you can't please all people all of the time, wouldn't it make sense to stop trying?

P3 Unfortunately, sense often isn't driving our behavior. For social beings who desire love and belonging, wanting to be liked, and caring about the effect we have on others, is healthy and allows us to make connections. However, where we get into trouble is when our self-worth is dependent upon whether we win someone's approval or not.

P4 This need to be liked can be traced back to when we were children and were completely dependent on others to take care of us: Small children are not just learning how to walk and communicate, they are also trying to learn how the world works. We learn about who we are and what is expected of us based on interactions with others, so, to a four-year-old, if Mommy or Daddy doesn't like him or her, there is the danger that they will abandon them. We need to understand that when we desperately want someone to approve of us, it's being driven by that little kid part of us that is still terrified of abandonment.

P5 As you become more capable of providing yourself with the approval you seek, your need for external validation will start to vanish, leaving you stronger, more confident, and yes, happier in your life. Imagine how much time we lose each moment we restrain our authentic selves in an effort to be liked.

P6 If we base our worth on the opinions of others, we cheat ourselves of the power to shape our experiences and embrace life not only for others but also for ourselves, because ultimately, there is no difference. So embrace the cliché(老话) and love yourself as it's highly doubtful that you'll regret it.

questions.q: What can we conclude from Lao Zi's quotation?
options: We should see through other people's attempt to make a prisoner of us.
We can never really please other people even if we try as hard as we can.
We can never be truly free if taking to heart others' opinion of us.
We should care about other people's view as much as they care about our own.
questions.explain:
【判型】题干What can we conclude from Lao Zi's quotation?含conclude，要求由引语推出结 论，而非复述字面。 46. What can we conclude from Lao Zi's quotation? A) We should see through other people's attempt to make a prisoner of us. B) We can never really please other people even if we try as hard as we can. C) We can never be truly free if taking to heart others' opinion of us. D) We should care about other people's view as much as they care about our own.

【拆句】题干What can we conclude from Lao Zi's quotation?是常规 wh- 疑问句，主干为 What can we conclude，from 介词短语修饰 conclude，结构平直，无陷阱。

【定位】Lao Zi once said, "Care about what other people think and you will always be their prisoner." 老子曾说：在意别人怎么想，你就会永远做他们的囚徒。

【选项】A) 把比喻当字面属偷换概念 see through other people's attempt to make a prisoner of us把 prisoner 当成真有 人想囚禁我们，原文是比喻、不是有人主动加害。 B) 张冠李戴 We can never really please other people even if we try as hard as we can.说的是 讨好不可能成功，这是If it's true that you can't please all people all of the time的内 容，不是P1老子那句引语的结论。 C) ✓ 正确 Care about what other people think ↔taking to heart others' opinion of us you will always be their prisoner ↔can never be truly free We can never be truly free if taking to heart others' opinion of us.同时覆盖了原文 if-then 链条的两端，是定位句的完整同义改写。 D) 无中生有 as much as they care about our own提出一种对等关心的主张，但P1引语只说在意他 人会失自由，根本未涉及对方是否在意我们。 如果我们将自我价值建立在他人的认可之上,会发生什么? A) 我们被爱的渴望将得到满足。 B) 我们的生活将变得毫无成果且令人疲惫。 C) 我们作为社会存在的身份将受到影响。 D) 我们的自我意识将被强化和增强。

questions.q: What will happen if we base our self-worth on other people's approval?
options: Our desire to be loved will be fulfilled.
Our life will be unfruitful and exhausting.
Our identity as social beings will be affected.
Our sense of self will be sharpened and enhanced.
questions.explain:
【判型】题干What will happen if we base our self-worth on other people's approval?问的是一 种行为的直接后果，答案应来自原文对应描述句的客观转述。

【拆句】题干What will happen if we base our self-worth on other people's approval?是 if 引 导条件状语从句的疑问句，主干 What will happen，base A on B 是固定搭配，意为以B为 基础。

【定位】People-pleasing, or seeking self-worth through others' approval, is unproductive and an exhausting way to go through life. 讨好他人，或者说通过他人的认可来寻求自我价值，是一种无成效且令人疲惫的活法。 47. What will happen if we base our self-worth on other people's approval? A) Our desire to be loved will be fulfilled. B) Our life will be unfruitful and exhausting. C) Our identity as social beings will be affected. D) Our sense of self will be sharpened and enhanced.

【选项】A) 与原文相反 原文将该行为定性为 unproductive、exhausting，选项Our desire to be loved will be fulfilled.却说愿望被满足，与原文极性相反。 B) ✓ 正确 unproductive ↔unfruitful an exhausting way to go through life ↔exhausting Our life will be unfruitful and exhausting.同时覆盖了原文两个评价形容词 unproductive 与 exhausting，正合预判。 C) 无中生有 For social beings who desire love and belonging是描述人之常情，原文并未说 social beings 这一身份会因 people-pleasing 而被影响。 D) 与原文相反 where we get into trouble is when our self-worth is dependent upon whether we win someone's approval or not说明此举使自我陷入麻烦，Our sense of self will be sharpened and enhanced.却说自我被强化，正好相反。 什么可以解释我们需要被喜欢或认可? A) 我们对与他人互动的强烈渴望。 B) 我们对世界运作方式的理解。 C) 我们对被抛弃之痛的认知。 D) 我们早期童年时对被遗弃的恐惧。

questions.q: What may account for our need to be liked or approved of?
options: Our desperate longing for interactions with others.
Our understanding of the workings of the world.
Our knowledge about the pain of abandonment.
Our early childhood fear of being deserted.
questions.explain:
【判型】题干What may account for our need to be liked or approved of?问一种心理需求的成 因，原文若给出明确解释句，答案即其同义改写。

【拆句】题干What may account for our need to be liked or approved of?主语是 What，谓语 may account for，宾语为 our need to be liked or approved of。be liked 与 be approved of 是两个并列被动不定式，approved of 中 of 不可省，因 approve of 是固定 及物动词短语。

【定位】This need to be liked can be traced back to when we were children and were completely dependent on others to take care of us… We need to understand that when we desperately want someone to approve of us, it's being driven by that little kid part of us that is still terrified of abandonment. 这种想被喜欢的需求可以追溯到我们还是孩子、完全依赖他人照料的时候……我们要明白， 当我们极度渴望得到他人认可时，背后真正驱动的，是那个仍然害怕被遗弃的小小孩子。 48. What may account for our need to be liked or approved of? A) Our desperate longing for interactions with others. B) Our understanding of the workings of the world. C) Our knowledge about the pain of abandonment. D) Our early childhood fear of being deserted.

【选项】A) 偷换概念 We learn about who we are and what is expected of us based on interactions with others里 interactions 是孩子学习自我的途径，不是渴望被喜欢的成因。 B) 偷换概念 they are also trying to learn how the world works说孩子在学习世界运转方式，这是 孩子在做的事，不是想被喜欢的成因。 C) 偷换概念 knowledge about the pain of abandonment说我们已经知道被遗弃的痛苦；原文实 际说的是儿童害怕被遗弃 still terrified of abandonment，是恐惧而非已掌握的知识。 D) ✓ 正确 when we were children ↔early childhood terrified of abandonment ↔fear of being deserted Our early childhood fear of being deserted.同时锁住了童年这个时间端与害怕被遗弃 这个情感端，与原文因果链根源端完全对应。 当我们更有能力为自己提供所渴望的认可时,我们能做什么? A) 享受更幸福的生活。 B) 实行自我克制。 C) 获得更多外部认可。 D) 增强我们的想象力。

questions.q: What can we do when we become better able to provide ourselves with the desired approval?
options: Enjoy a happier life.
Exercise self-restraint.
Receive more external validation.
Strengthen our power of imagination.
questions.explain:
【判型】题干What can we do when we become better able to provide ourselves with the desired approval?问的是某条件下发生的事/可获得的结果，属直接的客观陈述。

【拆句】题干What can we do when we become better able to provide ourselves with the desired approval?主句是 What can we do，when 引导时间状语从句。从句主干 we become…able to…，better 修饰形容词 able。provide sb. with sth. 是固定搭配，意为 给…提供…。

【定位】As you become more capable of providing yourself with the approval you seek, your need for external validation will start to vanish, leaving you stronger, more confident, and yes, happier in your life. 当你越来越能给自己所寻求的认可时，你对外部认可的需要会开始消退，让你变得更强、更 自信、并且——是的——在生活中更幸福。 49. What can we do when we become better able to provide ourselves with the desired approval? A) Enjoy a happier life. B) Exercise self-restraint. C) Receive more external validation. D) Strengthen our power of imagination.

【选项】A) ✓ 正确 happier in your life ↔happier life Enjoy a happier life.精准对应三个并列结果中的最后一项 happier in your life，且最直 白、无歧义。 B) 与原文相反 原文we restrain our authentic selves是把克制真实自我描述为浪费时间的行为，不是 该条件下我们应做的事；Exercise self-restraint.反而把原文要批判的行为当成了结果。 C) 与原文相反 your need for external validation will start to vanish明确说对外部认可的需求会消 退，Receive more external validation.却说获得更多，方向相反。 D) 偷换概念 Imagine how much time we lose…是作者修辞性祈使，引导读者去想象浪费的时间， 并不是说我们会去强化想象力。 作者在最后一段建议我们做什么? A) 为自己和他人拥抱生活。 B) 将我们的价值建立在他人的看法之上。 C) 将我们的经历视为财富。 D) 爱现在的自己。

questions.q: What does the author advise us to do in the last paragraph?
options: Embrace life for ourselves and for others.
Base our worth on others' opinions.
See our experiences as assets.
Love ourselves as we are.
questions.explain:
【判型】题干What does the author advise us to do in the last paragraph?限定段落+问具体建 议，按位置直接精读末段祈使句即可。

【拆句】题干What does the author advise us to do in the last paragraph?是 wh- 疑问句，主干 What does the author advise us to do，advise sb. to do sth. 是固定搭配，in the last paragraph 是地点状语限定范围。

【定位】So embrace the cliché(老话) and love yourself as it's highly doubtful that you'll regret it. 所以拥抱这句老话——爱自己吧，你几乎不可能后悔。 50. What does the author advise us to do in the last paragraph? A) Embrace life for ourselves and for others. B) Base our worth on others' opinions. C) See our experiences as assets. D) Love ourselves as we are.

【选项】A) 偷换概念 embrace life not only for others but also for ourselves说不仅为他人也为自己拥抱生 活，是过渡论述，不是末段 So 之后给出的最终建议；选项Embrace life for ourselves and for others.把它包装成建议，越权代替了真正的祈使句。 B) 与原文相反 If we base our worth on the opinions of others, we cheat ourselves of the power to shape our experiences明确指出以他人评价为基础是自我欺骗，作者反对这一做 法，Base our worth on others' opinions.反而把它当建议。 C) 无中生有 原文the power to shape our experiences说的是塑造自身体验的力量，不是把体验视 为财富。See our experiences as assets.借 experiences 一词制造表层相似，实则原文 从未把它定义为 assets。 D) ✓ 正确 love yourself ↔Love ourselves as we are Love ourselves as we are.忠实保留了原文祈使动作 love+反身代词的结构，是末段建 议的直译版。
